capabilities: Search all vault Markdown files for a match
Replace matches using regex, case sensitivity, and special replacement patterns
Cycle through matches with arrow keys
Open the note at a match from the results
extras: Documents JavaScript-style special replacement patterns ($&, $n, named groups) that only apply when the search pattern is a regular expression.
problem: Obsidian's core Search finds text but does not replace it across every file, so vault-wide changes must be made file by file.
summary: Search and replace utility that finds matches across all Markdown files in a vault, with regex and case-sensitive support.
